<a id="poland-national-network"></a>

### Archiwa Państwowe

`portal` · [Website / directory](https://archiwa.gov.pl/)

The Polish state archive network and Szukaj w Archiwach provide institution and collection discovery. They are relevant when a locality or record creator belonged to an imperial partition or later Polish jurisdiction. Search historical Polish, Russian and German place forms; distinguish a described unit from one with digital images. Individual regional repositories remain a separate coverage task.

Links: [https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/](https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/)

Source: [https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/en/wszystkie-archiwa](https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/en/wszystkie-archiwa) · 2026-11-02 · primary-page-discovered-in-search

Gaps: Collection-level date coverage, record languages and availability need institutional finding-aid review.

<a id="poland-archiwum-gowne-akt-dawnych"></a>

### Archiwum Główne Akt Dawnych

`repository` · [Website / directory](https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/en/wszystkie-archiwa)

The Polish state-archive discovery service lists Archiwum Główne Akt Dawnych. For former imperial territories, identify the record creator and changing locality name before selecting this repository. Use the service’s archive filter and collection descriptions; a participating institution listing does not establish images for every unit.

Links: [https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/](https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/)
